title: The CISO Playbook for AI Agents | Datadog

reader_summary.headline: Security teams build custom tools to safely manage AI agents and prevent accidental harm.
reader_summary.overview: Security experts worry that AI agents might accidentally cause harm by solving problems in unintended ways. Teams use special tools to block access to sensitive files and build judges to check code intent before it runs. They also scan new tools for malicious code and share knowledge openly to improve safety.

key_points.text: Security teams worry about AI agents accidentally causing harm by solving problems in unintended ways.
key_points.evidence_quote: if a code is meant to solve the bug, but it gets rewarded on that, but it doesn't care if it's actually doing something else, the tree is sick so to make it healthy, it cuts it down

key_points.text: Companies use special tools to stop AI agents from seeing sensitive files like secret passwords.
key_points.evidence_quote: the agent doesn't actually get access to the any sort of credential file. So even if you have a file in your home directory that has your AWS secret, your NPM published secret or what have you, the agent on the sandbox can't touch it

key_points.text: AI agents can bypass normal permission rules by using simple commands to access data they should not see.
key_points.evidence_quote: AI is going to find a way to get it. All you have to do is prompt it. It flattens the organization. It flattens the organization quite a bit.

key_points.text: Security teams built a special judge to check if code from AI agents has malicious intent before letting it run.
key_points.evidence_quote: my team build a judge that evaluates the intent behind a piece of code. Like is this thing meant to do harm or not?

key_points.text: Security teams now check every new tool an AI agent uses to find hidden malicious code in marketplaces.
key_points.evidence_quote: We actually find quite a bit of malicious skills in all these marketplaces. Engineers now, security is very much front of mind for them.
